label: Agency site: four pages, Swiss International variation, custom template on contact
instruction: We are an eleven person brand and product agency called Marlow Grid. Build the site: home, services, a work archive and contact. Use the Swiss International look.

response.summary: A four page site for a brand and digital agency, reskinned to the Swiss International variation, with a dedicated work archive and a contact page on the no-title template.

content.headline: Systems, Not Logos
content.body: Marlow Grid builds brand systems that survive contact with a product team: tokens, type scales and rules that designers and engineers can both hold.

content.headline: Three Things, Done Properly
content.item1Body: Naming, identity, type and colour delivered as a documented system rather than a folder of finished artwork.
content.item2Body: Interface work built on the same tokens as the brand, so the marketing site and the product stop diverging.
content.item3Body: We hand over running code: design tokens, a component library and the documentation your team will actually read.

content.headline: Consistency Is A Budget
content.body: Every inconsistency in a brand costs somebody an hour later: a designer redrawing a button, an engineer guessing a spacing value, a marketer rebuilding a template.
content.bodySecondary: We treat that as a budget to be spent deliberately, which is why our deliverable is a system with rules rather than a set of beautiful and unrepeatable pages.

content.headline: Tell us what is inconsistent
content.body: Most engagements start with an audit of what already exists. Send us a link and we will tell you honestly whether you need us.

content.headline: How An Engagement Runs
content.item1Body: Two weeks reading what you already have, ending in a written list of what is inconsistent and what it is costing.
content.item2Body: Eight to twelve weeks building the brand or product system, reviewed with your team every Friday.
content.item3Body: Tokens, components and documentation handed to your engineers, with a month of support while they adopt it.

content.headline: We Work In The Open
content.body: There is no big reveal. Work is reviewed weekly in whatever state it is in, because a system built without the team that has to use it is a system that quietly gets abandoned.
content.bodySecondary: Pricing is fixed per phase and published in the proposal. If a phase runs long, that is our problem rather than an invoice.

content.headline: Three studios, one inbox
content.body: New business goes to one address wherever you are. We answer within a working day and will say no quickly if we are not right for it.
